summary: Two fresh independent Luna reviews rejected exact head a5530f9d. GitHub evidence still has an impossible same-run completion dependency, permits extra runner-group members, and allows omitted runtime bindings. Lifecycle code can leave sudo active on early failures, under-validates unrelated privileged inventory, lacks protocol read timeout, documents the wrong cleanup record, and does not SIGTERM-test every publication boundary.
validation: GitHub-evidence reviewer inspected complete e3ff9662..a5530f9d diff against REQ-002/010/012 and REV4-001..003.
Lifecycle reviewer independently inspected the same exact diff against REQ-001/003..009/011 and REV4-004..008.
Reviews were read-only: no edit, commit, push, PR mutation, dispatch, install, merge, deployment, or live authorization change occurred.
Both reviewers preserved the external protected-group-7 gate and did not treat historical group-6 evidence as a substitute.
blockers: REV5-001 HIGH: Redesign evidence sequencing; the current run requires evidence before its job while the producer requires that same job completed/success, so no valid current-run evidence can exist.
REV5-002 HIGH: Authoritative verifier must require memberRunnerIds exactly [6252], rejecting any extra runner-group member with negative coverage.
REV5-003 HIGH: Make run ID/attempt/workflow path/ref/SHA binding mandatory for every gate invocation and test every omitted argument.
REV5-004 HIGH: Acquire the root lock and revoke/fsync sudo authorization before identity, visudo, admission-root, directory, or other fallible lifecycle validation.
REV5-005 HIGH: Validate unrelated privileged inventory entries as root-owned, non-writable, single-link, descriptor/race-stable regular files; type-only checks are insufficient.
REV5-006 MEDIUM: Add a bounded deadline to the privileged stdin protocol read so a partial record cannot hold a sudo-root process indefinitely.
REV5-007 MEDIUM: Correct cleanup documentation to the exact three-line operation/capability/path protocol and mechanically test documentation parity.
REV5-008 MEDIUM: Abruptly terminate and recover every pending/stage/publication/sudo/cleanup boundary, not only stage and ordinal 4.
next_action: Return all REV5 findings to one Luna remediation owner, update derived manifests/contracts/tests, then perform a final complete independent review at the new exact head.
